problem: After restoring personal LinkedIn publication, database identity triggers and the reconciler still assumed personal content always required first-person verified truth. The obligation also retained an obsolete LinkedIn permalink after a new provider URN was created.
root_cause: The personal-channel truth model evolved in Edge Functions before all database guards and reconciliation paths were updated. Evidence merging also preserved stale transport fields from the rejected historical post.
decision: Make verified first-person personal truth and verified source-backed observational personal-life content two explicit valid truth modes across pre-publish review, artifact trigger, obligation trigger and reconciliation. Derive canonical LinkedIn permalinks from the exact provider URN.
prevention: All personal LinkedIn enforcement layers must recognize the same two truth modes.
Observational mode requires public source verification, personal-life topic, no first-person experience claim, no business topic and no corporate voice.
Consumer-tech words such as AI are not automatically business content in observational daily-life posts; business blocking remains based on actual business context.
A new LinkedIn provider URN must replace stale canonical/public/readback URLs.
Terminal publication evidence is provider create acknowledgement plus exact public copy proof; ACL-limited structured post reads may remain permission-limited.
